Container.Name: stravakudos
Container.Overview: Automated Strava kudos bot. Logs in to Strava and gives kudos to all recent activities in your feed. On first run (or when your session expires), open the noVNC web UI to log in manually — the bot emails you a link when it needs you.

Config.Name: noVNC Web UI
Config.Description: Browser-based VNC interface. Open this to log in to Strava manually on first run or after session expiry.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores the Strava session cookie, run stats, and error screenshots.

Config.Name: Gmail Email
Config.Description: Gmail address used for notifications and one-time code reading.

Config.Name: Gmail App Password
Config.Description: Gmail App Password (not your main Google password). Generate one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.

Config.Name: Notify Email
Config.Description: Email address to receive login-required alerts and failure notifications.

Config.Name: noVNC URL
Config.Description: URL included in login notification emails so you can click straight to the browser. Leave as default unless you're behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Max Kudos per Run
Config.Description: Safety cap on the number of kudos given per run.

Config.Name: Lookback Hours
Config.Description: Only kudos activities posted within this many hours.

Config.Name: Run Interval Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes between kudos runs. Set to 0 to run once and exit (useful for testing).
